prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 14 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1205; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the vehicle was changing lanes. Reported symptoms at initial evaluation included headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, difficulty concentrating, and intermittent nausea. No loss of consciousness was reported, though the patient described brief disorientation immediately after impact. Neurological examination showed mild balance deficits and mild visual tracking difficulty; cranial nerve function and motor strength were otherwise intact. Cognitive screening identified deficits in processing speed and short-term recall consistent with a concussion.

Care consisted of 14 outpatient visits over the course of recovery. Treatment included relative rest during the acute phase, a graduated return to cognitive and physical activity, vestibular and balance exercises, and vision-focused therapy. Symptoms were tracked at each visit using a standardized symptom scale. Symptoms improved steadily, with headaches and dizziness resolving first and concentration deficits resolving last. At discharge the patient was asymptomatic at rest, tolerating full daily activities, and cleared for a full return to work and driving, with instructions to seek care promptly if symptoms recur.
